answer: Proposal: submitter-funded verification. An identity burns a bond covering the real cost of peer review to enter an epoch's reward round; only a passing verdict pays, with reward R capped per identity. Whether the task is tagging willow plots, sampling a lagoon, or surveying a canyon, filler fails review. If a weak submission passes with probability p, set the bond above p·R; then n aliases pay n bonds for the same bad odds, so volume loses money. Assumes reviewers spot filler better than chance; limit: a captured jury sells verdicts.
